dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The weather in this area has improved quite a bit, mostly thanks to you two.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Once the dark clouds have dispersed and the sun shines down on us once more, the monsters will no longer be able to sneak out under the cover of darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And when that day comes, the Lightkeepers stationed here will finally be able to rest.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: True... Ah, if only it could always be daytime. Say, do you think the sun's kinda like us Ratniki?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I mean, before the sun lit up the skies, the world could only have known darkness. What I'm trying to say is, if it wasn't for the sun, there wouldn't be a "daytime" at all.

choices.text: You'd get daytime off, at most.
